ud5.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
ud5.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī ahosi,
ud5.3:1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
ud5.3:2.1: addasā kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī taṃ mahājanakāyaṃ dūratova sannipatitaṃ.
ud5.3:2.3: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho ettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā bhājīyissati.
ud5.3:2.5: appevanāmettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā labheyyanti”.
ud5.3:3.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī yena so mahājanakāyo tenupasaṅkami.
ud5.3:3.2: addasā kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ.
ud5.3:3.4: “na kho ettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā bhājīyati,
ud5.3:3.5: samaṇo ayaṃ gotamo parisatiṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
ud5.3:4.1: atha kho bhagavā sabbāvantaṃ parisaṃ cetasā cetoparicca manasākāsi
ud5.3:4.2: “ko nu kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātuṃ?”ti.
ud5.3:4.3: addasā kho bhagavā suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinnaṃ,
ud5.3:4.6: suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ ārabbha ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ?
ud5.3:4.7: dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ca2 ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
ud5.3:4.8: yadā bhagavā aññāsi, suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ. atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi,
ud5.3:4.10: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
ud5.3:4.11: evameva suppabuddhassa kuṭṭhissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
ud5.3:5.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.3:6.2: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī”ti. evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
ud5.3:6.3: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
ud5.3:6.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu, ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.
ud5.3:7.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito, samādapito, samuttejito, sampahaṃsito, bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
ud5.3:7.2: atha kho suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ acirapakkantaṃ gāvī taruṇavacchā adhipātetvā jīvitā voropesi.
ud5.3:8.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
ud5.3:8.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
ud5.3:8.3: “yo so bhante, suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito, samādapito, samuttejito, sampahaṃsito, so kālakato.
ud5.3:9.1: “paṇḍito bhikkhave, suppabuddho kuṭṭhī. paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
ud5.3:9.2: suppabuddho bhikkhave, kuṭṭhī tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.
ud5.3:10.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.3:10.2: “ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena suppabuddho kuṭṭhī ahosi,
ud5.3:11.1: “bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave suppabuddho kuṭṭhī imasmiṃ yeva rājagahe seṭṭhiputto ahosi.
ud5.3:11.2: so uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto addasa tagarasikhiṃ paccekabuddhaṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pavisantaṃ,
ud5.3:11.6: so tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye paccittha.
ud5.3:11.7: tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena imasmiṃ yeva rājagahe kuṭṭhī ahosi, manussadaḷiddo manussakapaṇo manussavarāko.
ud5.3:11.8: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādiyi, sīlaṃ samādiyi, sutaṃ samādiyi, cāgaṃ samādiyi, paññaṃ samādiyi.
ud5.3:11.9: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
ud5.3:11.10: so tattha aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cāti.
ud5.3:12.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
